nodes.label: Forge phone session log (session.md)
nodes.rationale: Locked baseline record: preserves tooling limits, script paths, and locked product state so future sessions do not rediscover them.

nodes.label: INVARIANTS.md
nodes.rationale: Never delete folders without explicit user permission.

nodes.label: BUILD.md runbook
nodes.rationale: Committed to repo and GitHub so build/release/i18n procedure survives device reset.

nodes.label: www/index.html (canonical host)
nodes.rationale: Canonical host UI + ForgeHost; must stay identical to assets copy before build; keep AI tools/attachments fix when touching UI.

nodes.label: android/.../assets/public/index.html
nodes.rationale: Shipped copy of host; must match www/index.html before running build_forge.sh.

nodes.label: www/index.html.with-live-backup
nodes.rationale: WIP live-translate host dump kept as reference only; do not ship or copy to assets without diff review.

nodes.label: build_forge.sh
nodes.rationale: Wraps Gradle assembleDebug so rebuilds are one command.

nodes.label: Forge-debug.apk (original, untouched)
nodes.rationale: Preserved unmodified user binary for absolute binary identity comparison.

nodes.label: Forge-debug-rebuilt.apk (canonical Gradle build)
nodes.rationale: Canonical rebuild output installed via adb install -r.

nodes.label: MainActivity.java
nodes.rationale: Locked to original JADX shape (plugins + intent forward + keepWebViewAlive only) to preserve APK-faithful chrome.

nodes.label: MicBridgePlugin.java
nodes.rationale: Native startStream/stopStream PCM methods kept in tree even when host wiring was rolled back, so live-translate can re-land incrementally.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.ai.chat
nodes.rationale: Fixed beyond APK intentionally: forwards tools/tool_choice, returns tool_calls, normalizes attachments — must survive UI reverts.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.mic.startStream/stopStream
nodes.rationale: Patch 1 of live-translate re-land: smallest safe host wire with events only.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.ai.transcribe / ai.stt
nodes.rationale: Patch 2: reuses existing Whisper/xAI /stt path; rejects Gemini because it lacks STT.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.ai.liveTranslate
nodes.rationale: Patch 3: mic PCM → windowed STT → chat translate → optional TTS session, landed incrementally after the bulk-inject attempt broke the host UI.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.audio route API
nodes.rationale: Best-effort routing (auto/speaker/earpiece/wired/bluetooth/communication) so TTS can target an output device.

nodes.label: DriveBridge (SAF library backup)
nodes.rationale: Uses Storage Access Framework rather than OAuth Drive API so any picked folder (incl. Google Drive) works without API credentials.

nodes.label: OpenHtmlBridge
nodes.rationale: Captures WhatsApp/Files/Drive shares and cold-start VIEW intents so arbitrary HTML imports into the library.

nodes.label: CameraBridgePlugin (takePhoto)
nodes.rationale: Waits for flushed ≥2KB JPEG with SOI magic and accepts cancelled-result files because OEM camera apps misreport success/failure.

nodes.label: Forge_AI_Chat sample HTMLs
nodes.rationale: Fixed to actually pass attachments and bind tools via host ai.chat; must be re-imported on device if stale.

nodes.label: Menu_Translator.html + prompt
nodes.rationale: Camera thumbs via setImg/fallback; AI attachments never blob:.

nodes.label: Forge_Live_Translate.html (mini-app draft)
nodes.rationale: Draft expects host live events/APIs; not usable until liveTranslate host APIs are present.

nodes.label: Kitchen sink lab (app_kitchensink)
nodes.rationale: Documents the full ForgeHost surface and positions Forge as a kitchen-sink runtime for arbitrary HTML mini-apps.

nodes.label: Locked product baseline (2.6.72/102)
nodes.rationale: Locks selects/theme/MainActivity to original APK behavior while keeping the intentional AI tools/attachments host fix.

nodes.label: Live streaming translation pipeline
nodes.rationale: Mic PCM chunks → STT windows → stream chat translate → host events → mini-app UI; bulk injection broke host UI, so it is re-landed in four small patches.

nodes.label: Drive Backup AI Settings
nodes.rationale: Backup/Restore now covers ForgeLibrary/settings.json so users can move provider profiles and keys across devices; merge restore overlays remote onto local to keep local keys when remote is empty.

nodes.label: CameraXCaptureActivity
nodes.rationale: Avoid OEM ACTION_IMAGE_CAPTURE by using in-process CameraX Preview/ImageCapture so capture stays inside the app.

nodes.label: __forgeNormalizeMediaResult
nodes.rationale: Host-injected normalization keeps mini-apps thin and guarantees base64 + real dataUrl + previewUrl/blobUrl regardless of capture source.

nodes.label: Library AAForge Readiness Light
nodes.rationale: Green/red indicator reflects whether an app uses only APIs the AAForge reduced host can call; HTML scan runs only on Drive/folder Restore to avoid rescanning on library load/import/save/share.

nodes.label: addDriveTombstone
nodes.rationale: Tombstone on every delete lets the next Backup purge apps/<id>/ from the Drive folder without a per-delete backup checkbox.

nodes.label: AI Tab Buttons Dead Fix
nodes.source_location: Fix AI tab buttons dead after App-bar trim (2026-08-14)
nodes.rationale: Removed app-bar nodes caused mid-wiring throws that silently dropped all later listeners; optional chaining makes control wiring null-safe.

nodes.label: Reforge Mode Picker
nodes.rationale: Sheet before model call lets user choose Standard vs AA-compat contract rules; result carCompatible follows chosen mode rather than the global header toggle.

nodes.label: b64ToBlobUrl
nodes.rationale: While loop removes the i binding that threw during blob preview building; full try/catch keeps normalize failures non-fatal.

nodes.label: Mini-app Console
nodes.rationale: Ring buffer of 500 lines capped ~8KB avoids base64 dumps while surfacing mini-app logs, errors, and failed host calls in the AI tab.

nodes.label: consoleHook
nodes.rationale: Console capture is a separate string concatenated after the bridge template so the bridge body is never edited — the design rule that keeps mini-apps alive.

nodes.label: Menu Translator Mini-app
nodes.rationale: Display and attach packaging were wrong in the mini-app, not the host camera APIs; fixed to match the AI Chat / ForgeCam / host docs contract.

nodes.label: setImgWithFallback
nodes.rationale: Fallback chain (host setImg → preview/blob/dataUrl → blob-from-base64 → dataUrl-from-base64) with createElement('img') avoids huge data: URIs inside innerHTML attributes that render blank in srcdoc.

nodes.label: toAiImagePart
nodes.rationale: Only real data: and/or base64 are valid vision input — never blob: URLs.

nodes.label: Gemini Provider (native)
nodes.rationale: Native generateContent endpoint replaces the broken /v1beta/chat/completions route; key validation accepts any prefix because Gemini keys do not always start with AIza.

nodes.label: Turn-key Free AI Setup
nodes.rationale: Provider selection was the main wall for non-technical users; wizard leads with plain-language free options and hides the full provider list behind Browse all providers.

nodes.label: openAppById
nodes.rationale: Made idempotent with a 2.5s dedupe so a resume from CameraX cannot re-trigger loadPreview and wipe in-flight camera.takePhoto promise/state.

nodes.label: Bridge String.raw Template Fix
nodes.source_location: Bridge media normalize `i is not defined` (2026-08-15)
nodes.rationale: Escapes inside a JS template literal are cooked, corrupting regexes in the srcdoc bridge; String.raw preserves backslashes while splitting </script> to keep host HTML parsing intact.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.radio API
nodes.rationale: GPS/hotspot almost always need system UI due to Android restrictions; Wi-Fi/BT toggles are best-effort with panel fallback.

nodes.label: PhoneBridge.readSms
nodes.rationale: Auto-requesting the sms permission alias in the bridge keeps mini-apps working even when they never call permissions.request themselves.

nodes.label: Generic LLM Tools Registry
nodes.rationale: A growing tool catalog over ForgeHost bridges lets chat/agents gain power as the host grows; new tools are picked up automatically by mini-apps using tools.list.

nodes.label: Forge Chat Mini-app
nodes.rationale: Uses ForgeHost.tools.list/run instead of a hardcoded 8-tool list so it inherits the live host catalog.

nodes.label: Reforge Tool Settings + Tools Migration
nodes.rationale: Injecting the live host catalog and mandating tools.list/run/hint migrates chat/agent apps off hardcoded APP_TOOLS while preserving chat UX.

nodes.label: Cheaper Inference Provider
nodes.source_location: Cheaper Inference provider + live model catalog (2026-08-16)
nodes.rationale: Wallet-backed OpenAI-compatible gateway offers many models below list price on one key; auto-detected from ir_live_ key shape and badged paid/wallet, not free.

nodes.label: btnRefreshModels
nodes.source_location: Cheaper Inference provider + live model catalog (2026-08-16)

nodes.label: forge_model_catalog_cache_v1
nodes.source_location: Cheaper Inference provider + live model catalog (2026-08-16)

nodes.label: Host www/index.html
nodes.source_location: Cheaper Inference provider + live model catalog (2026-08-16)

nodes.label: android/app/build.gradle
nodes.source_location: Cheaper Inference provider + live model catalog (2026-08-16)

nodes.label: forge_check.sh validation gate
nodes.rationale: Catches the recurring single-file host breakage modes (2.6.29/31/43/44): JS syntax, www/assets index.html parity, String.raw backtick-count sanity, stray raw </script>, version stamp drift between build.gradle and the host.

nodes.label: docs/api.md ForgeHost bridge reference
nodes.rationale: Filled the empty docs/ dir with citable references extracted from the inline SYSTEM_PROMPT / HOST_TOOL_REGISTRY so the SYSTEM_PROMPT could be slimmed.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.ai.agent tool-call loop
nodes.rationale: Centralized chat + tool-call loop with host-level risk sheet so confirm/danger tools require user approval.

nodes.label: agentAskMiniAppToolCall() mini-app veto gate
nodes.rationale: Makes the api.md onToolCall veto contract real: the host did not previously honor the callback return value.

nodes.label: MicBridgePlugin (native AEC/NS)
nodes.rationale: Fixes the live-translate TTS→mic echo noted in the 2.6.2 audio-routing section.

nodes.label: forge_docs_check.sh docs drift guard
nodes.rationale: Asserts docs/ mirrors the host; caught the 24-vs-27 tool drift on first run.

nodes.label: forge_smoke.sh on-device smoke harness
nodes.rationale: Complements forge_check.sh (syntax/parity) with runtime checks via adb; non-fatal by default.

nodes.label: SYSTEM_PROMPT (slimmed)
nodes.rationale: 70% reduction (2,751→~811 words): the exhaustive API dump caused lost-in-the-middle attention dilution on cheaper non-Grok models; the critical 'Return ONLY valid JSON' rule was buried under 2,400 words of reference docs.

nodes.label: startForgeProgress()
nodes.rationale: The chat dialog felt silent while the LLM was forging; a transient rotating progress line gives feedback while awaiting the reply.

nodes.label: toolsWebFetch (deferred #10)
nodes.rationale: Still does raw HTTP get + HTML strip; JS-rendered pages return near-empty. Next batch: add a Mozilla-Readability-style extraction or <article>/<main> selector before stripping.

nodes.label: release_forge.sh release script
nodes.rationale: Builds both distribution flavors (full APK + play AAB) from one source tree; aborts if the release keystore is missing.

nodes.label: forge-upload.jks release keystore
nodes.rationale: Both flavors signed with the same key so cross-store update preserves data; must be uploaded to Play App Signing (not Google-generated) so the F-Droid build can match. Losing it = can never update Forge on Play.

nodes.label: GPL-3.0 license (forge/LICENSE)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Apache-2.0 and a custom non-commercial license: GPL forces modified/distributed versions to stay open-source (stops closed-source commercial ripoffs) while keeping F-Droid eligibility; a non-commercial license would be non-free and F-Droid-rejected.

nodes.label: full/play distribution flavors
nodes.rationale: Path B: one-time $2.55 Play build (clean perms, auto-updates) + free full build for website/F-Droid/sideload. A newsletter/registration gate on the F-Droid build was explicitly rejected: violates F-Droid anti-features and is trivially fork-stripped.

nodes.label: isTransientNetworkError
nodes.rationale: Matches transient network error signatures (unable-to-resolve, unknownhost, ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED, etc.) so backgrounded-app network cuts can be distinguished from real API errors.

nodes.label: waitForVisible(maxMs)
nodes.rationale: OS restores network on resume, so retries should wait for the app to become visible before re-attempting.

nodes.label: nativeHttpPost(opts)
nodes.rationale: Android cuts network for backgrounded apps (Doze/Data Saver/Samsung sleeping-apps), so in-flight CapacitorHttp calls died with UnknownHostException; the host had zero retry for transient network errors. Up to 3 attempts with backoff, waits for foreground when hidden, honors AbortSignal, rethrows non-transient errors immediately.

nodes.label: nativeHttp({method, responseType, ...})
nodes.rationale: Generalized from nativeHttpPost in 2.6.66 so GET/arraybuffer paths (toolsHttpRequest, cloud TTS, fetchUrlAsDataUrl) could share the same transient-retry + foreground-wait behavior.

nodes.label: fetchWithTransientRetry()
nodes.rationale: Needed for patched-fetch one-shots (STT multipart) that cannot route through nativeHttp.

nodes.label: chatCompletions()
nodes.rationale: Primary chat path plus both response_format/tools-drop retries are wrapped in nativeHttpPost retry.

nodes.label: chatCompletionsStream
nodes.rationale: SSE streams are not retried by design; their WebView-fetch failure falls back to the retry-backed non-stream chatCompletions path.

nodes.label: toolsHttpRequest
nodes.rationale: web_search/web_fetch GETs were initially left unwrapped (small patch) in 2.6.65, then covered by nativeHttp in 2.6.66 because backgrounded tool rounds still errored.

nodes.label: fetchUrlAsDataUrl
nodes.rationale: Remote attachments needed the same transient-retry coverage.

nodes.label: aiFgsAcquire (unified FGS refcount)
nodes.rationale: One service, many owners: token Set + 1.2s grace before stop avoids start/stop churn between agent rounds, and prevents a finishing ai.chat from killing the live-translate or keepAwake service. FGS start failure is non-fatal because start-from-background is restricted on Android 12+; the retry layer covers it.

nodes.label: BackgroundForgeService (dataSync foreground service)
nodes.rationale: FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC in both flavors; already proven to keep network + JS alive in background by live-translate, so it was extended to all AI calls.

nodes.label: liveTranslateStart/Stop
nodes.rationale: Swapped direct BackgroundForge.start/stop for a held liveTranslateFgsRelease token so a finishing ai.chat can no longer kill the live-translate service.

nodes.label: keepAwake.start/stop (mini-app API)
nodes.rationale: Joins the refcount as a stack of releases so a concurrent AI call finishing cannot stop a mini-app's requested keep-awake.

nodes.label: MainActivity (insets listener)
nodes.rationale: Android 15 enforces edge-to-edge at SDK 35+, and Capacitor's CoordinatorLayout starves WebView inset listeners, so the fix listens on the decor view (root of insets dispatch) and applies margins instead of padding — Chromium WebView is unreliable about shifting content for setPadding; margins physically shrink the view bounds. This is the approach Capacitor 7 settled on.

nodes.label: RunActivity
nodes.rationale: Subclass of MainActivity, so the one insets fix covers every bridge-hosted mini-app window.

nodes.label: Capacitor BridgeActivity
nodes.rationale: Does no inset handling of its own (setContentView(bridge_layout_main)), which is why the WebView filled the entire screen under edge-to-edge.

nodes.label: CoordinatorLayout (bridge_layout_main.xml)
nodes.rationale: Dispatches window insets to children only when fitsSystemWindows=true; the WebView isn't marked, so a WebView-level listener was starved — root cause of the 2.6.68 fix failing.

nodes.label: FORGE_I18N dictionary (en/es/fr/pt/ja)
nodes.rationale: Minimal shape locked with user after 3 failed over-engineered attempts (dual mechanisms, Python toolchain, first-run gate, live re-render): dictionary, N copies, selector, restart-to-apply. ja is partial (~414/507 keys) because 93 ja strings had unrecoverable dropped bytes; t() falls back to English.

nodes.label: t(id, vars) lookup
nodes.rationale: {var} interpolation with English fallback for missing keys.

nodes.label: applyI18nDom
nodes.rationale: Applies data-i18n/-html/-ph/-title/-aria attributes once at boot — deliberately no live re-render; language change requires restart.

nodes.label: openExternalUrl
nodes.rationale: Used for the donate button so PayPal opens in the system browser (anchor target=_blank → external on Capacitor), keeping the donation link-out outside Google Play Billing scope.

nodes.label: extractJson
nodes.rationale: Parse the full text first; strip fences only when a single fence spans the whole reply, because the old first-fence match replaced the payload with garbage when the html string contained literal backtick fences. Later extended with brace scanning because GLM 'thinks out loud' echoing prompt fragments containing braces before emitting the payload.

nodes.label: reforgeAppWithAi
nodes.rationale: Switched to streaming variants (chatCompletionsStream / geminiStreamGenerateContent) because a streaming connection keeps receiving bytes so it rarely trips a socket read timeout, removing the 600s single-call cliff for slow models.

nodes.label: startGenWatchdog
nodes.rationale: Popup is non-blocking (pointer-events:none wrapper, z-index 150 below the console sheet) so the user can still open the AI tab and Console while the card is visible; the watchdog keeps running until generation settles, Fail now, or Stop.

nodes.label: genLog
nodes.rationale: Receiving progress throttled to ~20s so the 500-line console ring isn't flooded.

nodes.label: aiReadTimeoutMs
nodes.rationale: Returns max(600000, settingMs) so the socket never dies before the watchdog popup can extend — lets 'Extend' actually work on non-stream fallbacks.

nodes.label: chatCompletionsStream
nodes.rationale: flushEvent extended to accept non-standard content fields (delta.content/text/reasoning/output, top-level ev.content/text/output/response, choice.message) because GLM/Zhipu uses different field names; later reasoning fields were separated into reasoningAcc because reasoning is the scratchpad, not the answer.

nodes.label: forge_check.sh
nodes.rationale: Step 5 expected raw </script> count changed 2 → 1 because the pre-paint language-gate script was removed; only the host module block remains.

nodes.label: install.sh (Termux bridge)
nodes.rationale: Made idempotent (rm -f before cp to avoid ETXTBSY, ALREADY flag, fixed .bashrc guard matching HOME/bin instead of lowercase home/bin which caused a duplicate PATH line on every run). Ensure-python precondition added because the daemon child's output is discarded, so the install must run in the foreground where the user sees progress.

nodes.label: forge-termux-agent
nodes.rationale: Ensure-python block moved before the --daemon branch because the daemon child's output is discarded (nohup >/dev/null), so a missing-python failure was silent; the foreground check lets the user see install progress.

nodes.label: TermuxBridgePlugin
nodes.rationale: Java builtin agent strings kept in sync with the APK asset copy so both copies behave identically.

nodes.label: FORGE_LANGS
nodes.rationale: ko row restored (was dropped at 2.6.77 because the old pipeline never translated it); now a real option in the Language select.

nodes.label: i18n salvage dictionaries
nodes.rationale: 93 ja keys were re-translated because their source bytes were lossy (a C1 byte stripped in the old pipeline, unrecoverable by round-trip); they had fallen back to English via t().

nodes.label: Forge Host API Reference
nodes.rationale: Human-readable mirror of the canonical SYSTEM_PROMPT + ForgeHost bridge in forge/www/index.html; regenerated from the host when the bridge changes.

nodes.label: window.ForgeHost bridge (alias window.forge)
nodes.rationale: Injected into every mini-app iframe by the host before 'ready'; all host APIs are async Promises and mini-apps must never invent other native bridges.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.permissions
nodes.rationale: One-shot permission packs provide recommended UX for requesting grouped permissions.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.ai
nodes.rationale: Uses the user's configured providers/keys; API keys must never be embedded in mini-app HTML.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.ai.liveTranslate
nodes.rationale: Requires an STT provider (OpenAI/Groq/xAI, not Gemini); conversation mode auto-flips via Unicode-script detection for distinct-script pairs.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.storage
nodes.rationale: Per-app key/value storage namespaced by library id; preferred over window.localStorage which is unreliable in sandbox srcdoc.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.secrets
nodes.rationale: Per-app, lightly obfuscated at rest — not a hardware vault; used for mini-app API tokens, never host AI keys.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.files
nodes.rationale: File picking must always go through ForgeHost, never <input type=file> in the iframe.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.http
nodes.rationale: Native HTTP bypasses WebView/iframe CORS; inlineHtml must always be used before putting LLM HTML with external images into an iframe/srcdoc.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.sms
nodes.rationale: Prefer sms.compose (no permission, opens SMS app) over silent send unless the user wants automation; never SMS without an explicit user tap.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.phone
nodes.rationale: Prefer phone.dial (no permission) over silent call unless the user wants automation.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.contacts
nodes.rationale: Contacts must not be exfiltrated unless the user asked.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.apps / ForgeHost.intent
nodes.rationale: Prefer deep-link data URIs (wa.me, geo:, google.navigation:) over guessing activity class names; never launch without a user gesture.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.termux
nodes.rationale: Google Play Termux has no RUN_COMMAND and needs forge-termux-agent (localhost:8787); prefer termux.exec when output is needed; never run destructive scripts without an explicit user tap.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.notifications / ForgeHost.notify
nodes.rationale: Notification tap re-opens THIS mini-app with payload.

nodes.label: ForgeHost.tools (host LLM tools registry)
nodes.rationale: Chat/agent mini-apps must use tools.list/run rather than a hardcoded APP_TOOLS; danger tools only if the user enables danger risk and explicitly asks.

nodes.label: Forge Host LLM Tools Registry (docs/tools.md)
nodes.rationale: Human-readable mirror of HOST_TOOL_REGISTRY + HOST_BRIDGE_ALLOW in forge/www/index.html; regenerate when the registry changes.

nodes.label: ForgeHost bridge
nodes.rationale: Host exposes a tool catalog over ForgeHost bridges so chat/agent mini-apps gain power as the host grows.

nodes.label: HOST_BRIDGE_ALLOW (bridge_call allowlist)
nodes.rationale: termux.run / termux.exec are intentionally omitted from the default allowlist — they are danger-tier and not exposed via bridge_call.

nodes.label: bridge_call tool
nodes.rationale: Escape hatch to call a low-level host method by dotted name when no specialized tool fits; prefer named tools.

nodes.label: sms_send tool (danger)
nodes.rationale: Silent irreversible action; only when user explicitly asked.

nodes.label: phone_call tool (danger)
nodes.rationale: Silent irreversible action; only when user explicitly asked.

nodes.label: Risk tier system (safe/sensitive/confirm/danger)
nodes.rationale: danger-tier tools are excluded from tools.list unless riskMax:'danger' is passed.

nodes.label: Forge app (com.forge.live)
nodes.rationale: Designed to keep data on the device; no account, no advertising, no data selling.

nodes.label: BYO-AI provider model
nodes.rationale: Forge is BYO-AI: user provides own API key; only data leaving the device goes to providers the user chooses.

nodes.label: Optional Google Drive / folder backup
nodes.rationale: Backup contains API keys; Forge only reads/writes inside the user-chosen folder via Storage Access Framework.

nodes.label: Progress Bubble (.bubble.progress)
nodes.rationale: Transient rotating progress line shown while the LLM is forging (2.6.55).

nodes.label: Immersive Run Mode Exit Button (.app-exit)
nodes.rationale: Library / shortcut apps hide Forge chrome in immersive run mode; the exit button lets the user leave.
